name: Destiny's Cycle
source:
A visual novel made in a month where you play as a fox who is desperately trying to win the love of a rabbit.

[From [url=https://youchoosewhodies.itch.io/destinys-cycle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部花了一个月时间制作的视觉小说，你扮演一只狐狸，拼命想要赢得兔子的爱。

[来自[url=https://youchoosewhodies.itch.io/destinys-cycle]Itch.io[/url]]
